description: Core game music for menus, fanfares, and global areas

tracks.name: Modia - Realms of Destiny
tracks.sunoPrompt: Epic JRPG main menu theme, orchestral fantasy adventure, sweeping strings and heroic brass fanfare, Nobuo Uematsu inspired, sense of grand adventure beginning, majestic and inviting, journey awaits, moderate tempo building to crescendo

tracks.name: Choose Your Path
tracks.sunoPrompt: JRPG character selection theme, contemplative orchestral, gentle strings and soft brass, choosing destiny, anticipation and wonder, five races five paths, moderate calm tempo, thoughtful decision making

tracks.name: Triumph
tracks.sunoPrompt: Classic JRPG victory fanfare, triumphant brass and strings, celebratory and heroic, short non-looping jingle, battle won, experience gained, Final Fantasy inspired, 8-10 seconds, satisfying conclusion

tracks.name: Fallen Heroes
tracks.sunoPrompt: JRPG defeat jingle, somber strings descending, melancholic brass, party wiped, short non-looping, disappointment but not despair, try again soon, 5-8 seconds, classic game over tone

tracks.name: Power Ascending
tracks.sunoPrompt: JRPG level up fanfare, triumphant ascending melody, sparkling chimes and brass flourish, character growth, new strength gained, short celebratory jingle, 4-6 seconds, satisfying achievement sound

tracks.name: Arena of Legends
tracks.sunoPrompt: JRPG coliseum lobby theme, anticipatory orchestral, competitive energy building, brass fanfares and marching drums, warriors gathering, tournament atmosphere, moderate energetic tempo, glory awaits

tracks.name: Gathering of Heroes
